audit_items.proof_trace: In-memory cache pruning uses finalized_slot (current_epoch - ~2-4) instead of min_checked_data_availability_epoch (current_epoch - 4096). Line 481 passes finalized_slot to try_spawn_persist_data_columns_task, which calls prune_data_columns(finalized_slot) at line 566, deleting data columns after only ~2-4 epochs instead of the spec-mandated 4096 epochs.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Peer requests data column for slot at epoch current_epoch - 100 via DataColumnsByRootRequest. In-memory cache returns None (pruned at finalization 98 epochs ago). If storage was also pruned or node restarted, request fails despite being within 4096-epoch retention window. Node violates spec availability requirements.
